Experience Luxury Coastal Living in Bantry Bay

Experience the ultimate in coastal sophistication with this exquisite 3-bedroom, all en-suite apartment located in the heart of exclusive Bantry Bay. This elegant residence combines breathtaking ocean and mountain views with high-end finishes and a seamless indoor-outdoor flow.

The open-plan kitchen, dining, and lounge areas are designed for both comfort and entertaining, leading directly onto a sprawling outdoor terrace. Here you'll find a sunken lounge, two sparkling swimming pools, and a private jacuzzi, creating the perfect setting for sundowners or alfresco gatherings.

The main suite includes a private lounge area, offering a tranquil retreat within your home. Each of the three bedrooms is luxuriously appointed with en-suite bathrooms, ensuring privacy and comfort for residents and guests alike.

Property features include:
– 3 Bed
- 3.5 Bath
- 2 Car Garage
- 546m2
- Elevator access for convenience and privacy
– Double garage parking
- 2 Swimming Pools
– Wine cellar
- Jacuzzi

This is a rare opportunity to own a piece of paradise in one of Cape Town’s most sought-after locations.
